about: Hand-written expectations for #17 (tests/test_issue17_explicit_groups.py and tools/qualify_explicit_groups.py) over groups-and-periods.csv. Columns: Team (3), Service (4), Priority (5), each read at the first record in declared order. The stratum is Priority High at the first record: G01, G02, G04, G08. Within it, group A is the incidents first recorded with Team A, group B those with Team B: disjoint and of unequal size; G08's first Team is not recorded, so it is in neither. Their Service at the first record: G01 and G02 ERP, G04 not recorded. The overlapping explicit groups are those of expected.json. Never read by product code.
